hero.headline: Insights you build, not insights you get
hero.sub: An insight used to come with one drawing and you lived with it. Insights is now a set of boards: cards on a grid you drag and resize, each one built from blocks you pick and tune. Your team and your agents see the same board.

shot.alt: The Insights page on a board named Growth, with tabs for Product, Revenue, Growth and Funnels. Stat cards for MRR (4,920 USD), Monthly churn (4.4 %) and Trial-to-paid conversion (13.2 %), each with a sparkline, sit beside a wide area chart of Paying customers climbing from 12 to 41 between Jul 27 and Sep 21, and a bar for Weekly active teams at 171.
shot.caption: One board per tab. The ones you had before arrive as boards, one per category, in the order you kept them.

blocks.title: Change the chart, not the request
blocks.body: In Edit mode every card opens an inspector: the block's type, its data and every option it has (fill area, colour, series, row limit, and more). Each option visibly changes the drawing, and ⌘Z takes it back. You don't need to write any code.

shot.alt: The Growth board in Edit mode with an inspector open on the right for the Paying customers card. It lists the card's title and main insight, its single Line block, and the Line options: Type, Data, Dataset, a checked Fill area box, Color, Series and Row limit.
shot.caption: Add card, Done, and an inspector that names every option a block has.

blocks.title: A funnel you can take apart
blocks.body: The funnel explorer is a card of its own. Pick a platform, language or country and every page follows: the daily trend, the benchmark, the flow, the steps and a segments table per dimension. A step that wasn't measured is marked that way, not shown as zero.

shot.alt: A Signup funnel card with chips for Platform (Meta Ads, TikTok Ads, Unattributed), Language and Country, a 'Pin All traffic as a lane' control, and tabs Daily, Benchmark, Flow, Steps, Platform, Language and Country. The Daily tab shows Visit to lead over 28 days, with 'Checkout to purchase' struck through as not measured.
shot.caption: Up to four paths pinned as lanes, side by side.

blocks.title: The agent reads the same board you do
lines: [0] line paying-customers: Paying customers: 41 customers · 9 points 2026-07-27 → 2026-09-21
$ dreamcontext lab board add-card growth --insight mrr --block '{"stat":{"delta":true}}'
✗ card "c-mrr" at cards[2].blocks[0].stat.delta: must be one of none, prev (got true). Fix: set delta to one of none, prev.

blocks.title: A whiteboard that carries live numbers
blocks.body: Whiteboards are Excalidraw boards that you and your agent draw on together. A board can hold live insight cards, a task, a to-do list and notes next to the arrows, and a switcher at the top moves you between boards.

shot.alt: A whiteboard named 'Trial-to-paid war room' holding a Trial-to-paid conversion insight at 13.2 % with its chart, a Paying customers insight at 41, an in-progress task 'Investigate trial-to-paid drop', a 'This week' to-do list with three items, and a Hypothesis note.
shot.caption: Still Alpha, and labelled that way in the side menu.

blocks.text: Insights is Beta. My Reports are gone: boards replace them, and an old report's insights still have a place on a board. Nothing is written to your vault until your first edit.

closer.title: Open Insights and press Edit
closer.body: Your boards are already there. To get a funnel explorer, run Add card → Funnel explorer on an insight that has funnel data.
